## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D fantasy strategy game inspired by Heroes of Might and Magic III.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Created “Mythvale — Crown of the Wilds,” a browser-based 3D, turn-based strategy game using Three.js.
- Assumed core gameplay should include hero movement, resource collection, castle recruitment, and combat.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a Three.js game scene, stylized terrain and landmarks, hero model, responsive HUD, and modal styling.
- Added basic click-to-move/pathfinding, zoom/pan controls, turn/movement counters, landmark interactions, and castle recruitment code.
- Added Vite scripts and installed `three` and `vite`.

### Active
- Finish the gameplay implementation and verify the game in-browser.

### Blocked
- Current `game.js` ends after `recruit()`; battle handlers, end-turn handler, animation/render loop, and keyboard handlers are missing, so the scene does not render and the game is incomplete.
- No screenshot verification completed. An earlier browser run reported `ReferenceError: hero is not defined`, but that was before `game.js` was rewritten and is not yet rechecked.

## Next Move
1. Continue `game.js` after `recruit()` with battle flow, end-turn behavior, animation/render loop, and keyboard shortcuts.
2. Run `node --check game.js` and `npm run build`.
3. Open `http://localhost:3002` in the browser, check console errors, and save/read a current small JPEG screenshot.
4. Test movement, landmark rewards, recruitment, battle victory/retreat, and turn reset.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Core Three.js scene and gameplay code; currently incomplete at `recruit()`.
- `index.html`: Game HUD structure and app entry point.
- `style.css`: Game visuals and responsive UI styling.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and dependencies.
- `package-lock.json`: Dependency lockfile.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Development server was started in tmux session `mythvale` with `npm run dev`, on port `3002`.
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` successfully opened Chromium after installing the browser; it has not been rerun since the latest `game.js` rewrite.
